pages.text: $(lilomon)$(#503a30)When our powers met, brother's darkness and my light, a burst of both forged something new. a ring of both life and demise, the Ring of the One became true, we never thought dad will give us this truth...

$(lilomon)$(#503a30)It shown both of us, but a third at its center. i could not command off of it, neither could he.. i wonder what this center is, but i know. it was never for just one pair of flippers to hold.
